sanskrit_verse: तत्र शिष्टं छलं राजा मर्षयेद् धर्मसाधनः। भूतम् एव प्रपद्येत धर्ममूलाय श्रियः॥
transliteration: tatra śiṣṭaṃ chalaṃ rājā marṣayet dharmasādhanaḥ | bhūtam eva prapadyeta dharmamūlāyataḥ śriyaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The King, as the executor of Dharma, shall endure the remnants of deceit, for prosperity rooted in Dharma arises only from truthfulness.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derived from alignment with Dharma, not personal will
Causation flows from ontological integrity, not transactional deception
Capacity-based responsibility requires rulers to absorb distortions without retaliation
Restoration logic demands that all actions realign with foundational truth
Consciousness alignment necessitates sovereign immunity to falsity
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler encounters residual deceit THEN absorb without punitive response
IF societal prosperity is sought THEN enforce dharmic truth as causal root
IF governance capacity is active THEN reject retaliatory impulse as misaligned
IF dharma is operational THEN all surplus falsity resolves through sovereign endurance
IF consciousness integrity is maintained THEN material outcomes align automatically
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse establishes that judicial sovereignty lies in enduring systemic falsehoods without reactive judgment. The threshold of responsibility is not punitive enforcement but conscious absorption of distortion. Authority hierarchies must reflect dharmic grounding over coercive power.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that prosperity originates solely from adherence to Dharma. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that deceit dissolves when met with non-retaliatory clarity. Proportional responsibility rests entirely on maintaining alignment rather than correcting error. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that correction occurs naturally when Dharma is upheld.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate sovereign stillness protocol to neutralize residual falsity
Deploy consciousness anchoring procedures to restore ontological clarity
Activate dharma-field stabilization mechanisms to prevent recurrence
Engage completion resonance process to resolve karmic echoes of deceit
Reinforce societal integrity through renewed alignment practices
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this ruling executes Dharma as law. The King's role is defined by absorption of falsity, not its punishment. All prosperity emerges from unwavering commitment to truth. Reality responds only to consciousness alignment. Dharma is restored.
